findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "data_onchain_query" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "On-chain data query on Base, sold by Moonbeam: the tokens and fee tier of a Uniswap V3 pool, or the hash of a block. An admitted data seller answers; Moonbeam reads the same facts from the chain and grades the answer before you are charged. One call is 0.013714 USDC, paid with x402 on Base." → after: "One data.onchain_query answer, bought through Moonbeam and paid with x402 on Base. One call is 0.013714 USDC, paid with x402 on Base."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
